frontmatter.title: How I Got Remote Kernel Debugging Working on Windows 11 VMs Running on Proxmox
frontmatter.description: This article summarizes my suspected cause when KDNET-based remote kernel debugging failed between Windows 11 VMs on Proxmox, how I checked the VM settings from Proxmox, how I configured dbgsettings with an explicit busparams value, and the steps that finally made it work with qm start --force-cpu host.
